class_size_limits_001.evidence: action will be taken to maintain favorable class size in accordance with Board of Education policy and reduce classes which exceed by more than 10% the County-wide class size average based upon the 1973-74 figures only when the average exceeds twenty-five (25) for that grade level or subject field.

class_overage_remedy_004.evidence: If, subsequent to September 30, any teacher has a class which exceeds the county class size as indicated above, the teacher after consultation with the Principal may request a review by the FAC.
